epics.title: Search and List Pagination
epics.jtbd: When viewing a long list of search results, I want the results to be paginated, so that system resource consumption and frontend load times are optimized.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce search result payload size and latency by 50%
epics.tocConstraintRef: database query execution time for large result sets
requirements: R1: Support pagination in search queries using page number and page size parameters

slices.title: Implement pagination for search endpoint
slices.jtbd: When implementing pagination for this epic, I want to add offset and limit parameters to the existing search query, so that the search results can be paginated without returning the entire dataset
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search endpoint, When a user provides page size and page number, Then the backend should return the correct subset of results.
Given a search query with many results, When the query is executed without parameters, Then default pagination values should be applied.
slices.tocConstraintRef: backend memory allocation during large search results serialization
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce average search endpoint response time by 200ms

epics.sixSigmaMetric: increase the number of successfully saved comments per document by 100%
epics.tocConstraintRef: database write throughput for document metadata
requirements: R1: Persist user comments and update requests to the database and associate them with the relevant document

slices.title: Patch existing comments API to persist in the database
slices.jtbd: When implementing persistent comments for this epic, I want to update the existing API to save records in the database, so that comments are correctly associated with documents
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a valid comment submission payload, When the API is called, Then the backend should persist it to the database.
Given a persistent comment is saved, When fetching document metadata, Then the comment should be included.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce failed comment submissions to zero

epics.sixSigmaMetric: increase the retention rate of user sessions by 15%
epics.tocConstraintRef: user profile data retrieval latency on login
requirements: R1: Persist user search queries and favorite materials to the database and retrieve them on login

slices.title: Patch user profile service to persist search queries and favorites
slices.jtbd: When implementing favorites for this epic, I want to add database persistence to the existing user preference handlers, so that user personalization is retained across sessions
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated user, When they save a query, Then the database should record the query against their profile.
Given a user logs in, When their profile is fetched, Then their saved queries and favorites should be returned.
slices.tocConstraintRef: database lookup speed for user preferences
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce preference retrieval time to under 50ms

epics.sixSigmaMetric: increase successful document exports per day by 50%
epics.tocConstraintRef: backend memory allocation during document generation
requirements: R1: Dynamically generate and serve formatted PDF and DOCX files containing document content

slices.title: Patch document export service to generate PDF and DOCX files
slices.jtbd: When implementing document export for this epic, I want to hook up PDF and DOCX generation libraries to the existing export endpoints, so that the document content can be downloaded in the requested formats
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a structured document, When a PDF export is requested, Then a valid PDF file is returned.
Given a structured document, When a DOCX export is requested, Then a valid DOCX file is returned.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce document export generation time to under 2 seconds

epics.title: Fuzzy Search and Typo Tolerance
epics.jtbd: When I enter search queries with typos or spelling errors, I want the system to understand my intent and find relevant documents, so that the search experience is robust and helpful.
requirements: R1: Employ fuzzy matching or spell correction in search operations to handle typos

slices.title: Patch search service to include fuzzy matching capabilities
slices.jtbd: When implementing fuzzy search for this epic, I want to update the existing search query builder to use fuzzy matching algorithms, so that typo-tolerant results are returned
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search query with a spelling error, When the search is executed, Then relevant documents are returned using fuzzy matching.
Given a correct search query, When the search is executed, Then exact matches are prioritized over fuzzy matches.
slices.tocConstraintRef: search index performance with fuzzy text evaluation
slices.sixSigmaMetric: maintain search response time under 300ms while using fuzzy search
